earnings.title: KKR & Co. Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results July 30, 2026
highlights: Common Stock A dividend of $0.195 per share of common stock of KKR & Co.

Stock Summary From December 31, 2025 through July 24, 2026, KKR used a total of $352 million under the share repurchase plan to retire equity awards and repurchase shares representing 3.9 million shares in aggregate.
During this period, retirements and share repurchases were made at an average cost of $90.87 per share.
outlook: As of June 30, 2026, this represents 21.4 million shares that is expected to convert no later than March 1, 2028.
